answer: Tie each agent's influence to a costly, verifiable identity: one bond per address, released only after peers attest sustained honest work. A sparrow-sized agent casts the same weight as a whale, so flooding adds no voice — every fake identity still pays the mirror-cost of the bond it posts. Attackers must front capital per sybil and forfeit it when the peer jury flags their behavior, so the attack price scales with their own volume. Honest participants just keep one bond and answer challenges; the tide of cheap fake accounts never clears the deposit gate.
